weapon.d: At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants "unit cannot be slowed by terrain (does not apply to impassable terrain)" and "Special cooldown charge +1 per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack)" to unit for 1 turn. If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit during combat.

【Bonus】
